<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'parsed value'>">
  %ent;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY img SYSTEM "test.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/sub">
  <!-- Comment encompassing CDATA and entity references -->
  <sub:child id="c1">
    <![CDATA[
      Some CDATA text with <tags> and &internal; reference.
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % secMacro "<!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA | sub)*>">
  %secMacro;
  <!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY entityRef "Nested & Escaped Entity">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<document xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:xhtml="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <!-- Section comment block -->
  <xhtml:section>
    <![CDATA[
      <xhtml:p>CDATA with XHTML-like markup &entityRef;</xhtml:p>
    ]]>
  </xhtml:section>
  <section>&entityRef;</section>
</document>

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (table)*>
  <!ELEMENT table (col)*>
  <!ELEMENT col (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY db_name "TestDB">
  <!ENTITY % dtd_frag "<!ENTITY table_prefix 'tbl_'>">
  %dtd_frag;
  <!NOTATION sql SYSTEM "text/sql">
  <!ENTITY init_script SYSTEM "init.sql" NDATA sql>
]>
<?xml-action execute-query="true"?>
<database xmlns="http://db.example.org/ns" xmlns:db="http://db.example.org/ns">
  <!-- Database structural definitions and CDATA -->
  <db:table>
    <col>
      <![CDATA[
        CREATE TABLE &table_prefix;&db_name; (id INT PRIMARY KEY);
      ]]>
    </col>
  </db:table>
</database>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE config [
  <!ELEMENT config (setting)*>
  <!ELEMENT setting (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY timeout "30">
  <!ENTITY maxConn "100">
  <!ENTITY % perfConfig "<!ENTITY bufferSize '8192'>">
  %perfConfig;
]>
<?xml-config-options cache="true"?>
<config xmlns="http://config.example.org" xmlns:cfg="http://config.example.org/cfg">
  <!-- Configuration parameters and memory limits -->
  <cfg:setting name="timeout">&timeout;</cfg:setting>
  <setting>
    <![CDATA[
      Buffer allocation size: &bufferSize; bytes with max connections: &maxConn;
    ]]>
  </setting>
</config>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE soap:Envelope [
  <!ELEMENT soap:Envelope (soap:Body)>
  <!ELEMENT soap:Body (soap:Fault)>
  <!ELEMENT soap:Fault (faultcode, faultstring)>
  <!ELEMENT faultcode (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT faultstring (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY errorCode "Server.Processing">
  <!ENTITY errorDesc "An unexpected error occurred during processing.">
  <!NOTATION soap-error SYSTEM "urn:soap-error">
]>
<?xml-rpc-trace enabled="true"?>
<soap:Envelope xmlns:soap="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/">
  <!-- SOAP Fault envelope test case -->
  <soap:Body>
    <soap:Fault>
      <faultcode>&errorCode;</faultcode>
      <faultstring>
        <![CDATA[
          Detailed Error: &errorDesc; <stacktrace>NullPointerException</stacktrace>
        ]]>
      </faultstring>
    </soap:Fault>
  </soap:Body>
</soap:Envelope>
